extension.summary: 言語設定マネージャー
extension.description: Sets the audio and subtitle track according to your language preferences
Ställer in ljud- och undertextspår enligt dina språkinställningar
Imposta le tracce audio e dei sottotitoli in base alle preferenze linguistiche.
言語設定に従って音声トラックと字幕トラックを設定します。
Legt die Audio- und Untertitelspur entsprechend Ihren Spracheinstellungen fest
Définit les pistes audio et de sous-titres selon vos préférences linguistiques
extension.disclaimer: For bugs, requests or general questions visit the Language Preference Manager thread on the Kodi forum.
För buggar, önskemål eller allmänna frågor, besök tråden Language Preference Manager på Kodi-forumet.
Per bug, richieste o domande generali, visita il thread di Language Preference Manager sul forum Kodi.
バグ報告、要望、一般的な質問については、KodiフォーラムのLanguage Preference Managerスレッドをご覧ください。
Bei Fehlern, Anfragen oder allgemeinen Fragen besuchen Sie den Thread „Language Preference Manager“ im Kodi-Forum.
Pour signaler des bugs, faire des demandes ou poser des questions générales, consultez le fil « Language Preference Manager » sur le forum Kodi.
extension.news:
--- Version 2.0.15
- change: sub converter keeps ASS/SSA styles, fonts, colours and sign positions (an .ass copy); only bottom lines move to the top
--- Version 2.0.14
- change: sub converter reads the video in large blocks: much faster over network and http playback
--- Version 2.0.13
- change: sub converter works with http(s) and add-on (plugin) playback; headers and passwords are kept out of its log and file names
--- Version 2.0.12
- fix: sub converter no longer blocks the detection of subtitle changes made while it reads the video
--- Version 2.0.11
- change: sub converter works for any text subtitle format except SRT (ASS/SSA, WebVTT); picture subtitles (PGS/SUP, VobSub) cannot be converted without OCR and are left alone
--- Version 2.0.10
- change: sub converter works when the selected subtitle is ASS (other formats may be present) and places positioned lines at their exact spot
--- Version 2.0.9
- change: sub converter keeps the position of ASS lines that are positioned and moves only the unpositioned ones to the top
--- Version 2.0.8
- new: Sub converter: plain yellow top subtitles for Japanese, Korean or Chinese audio with only ASS subtitles
--- Version 2.0.7
- change: regex subtitle filter takes the first match, prefers the first ASS track, and no longer excludes whole-word matches
--- Version 2.0.6
- fix: the regex subtitle filter no longer takes a "Russian" (or other title with "ss") subtitle for a Signs & Songs track
--- Version 2.0.5
- change: Fast Subtitles Display is "Start & Resume" by default
--- Version 2.0.3
- new: the language of external subtitles is read from their file names in the video's folder (en-IN, pt-BR ...) - fix: stored preferences are never lost when the dialog and the service save at once; a failed delete is reported - fix: regions in track titles (PT-BR, ES-419), the Original audio list and Kodi 19-21 file names read right - fix: custom rules accept -ff and -ss together in any order - fix: nothing is applied when playback stops during the start delay
--- Version 2.0.2
- new: regional language variants: English (UK / US / Australia), Spanish (Spain / Latin America), French (Canada), Portuguese (Portugal), Chinese (Simplified / Traditional) in the language lists; custom tags such as en-AU, es-419, zh-Hant. The region is read from the track's tag or title (Kodi 22 drops it) - fix: Portuguese (Brazil) matches on Kodi 22 - fix: external subtitle files with a region in the name (Movie.pt-BR.srt, Movie.en-AU.srt) get the right language - fix: a subtitle Kodi pre-selected that matches the subtitle preferences is switched on and kept - fix: deleting a stored preference takes effect at once and is not written back - fix: a user switching back to the starting audio track after LPM changed it is stored - stored preferences save region and track title - translated: stored-preferences dialog, Log level setting; French and Swedish completed
